Third-party dependencies bundled for local browser processing

PDF.js 5.6.205 — Apache-2.0
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: pdfjs-dist-LICENSE.txt; standard_fonts/, cmaps/, wasm/ retain upstream licenses.

pdf-lib 1.17.1 — MIT
https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
License: pdf-lib-LICENSE.txt

@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 — MIT
https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
Authors: Andrew Dillon, Devon Govett.
Original package metadata and README with license declaration are retained in
fontkit-package.json and fontkit-README.md.
Distribution: https://unpkg.com/@pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1/dist/fontkit.umd.min.js

JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT or GPL-3.0; used under MIT
https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
License: jszip-LICENSE.txt

Carlito Regular — SIL Open Font License 1.1
https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito
License: Carlito-OFL.txt

Montserrat — SIL Open Font License 1.1
Reused from dashboard/static/Montserrat.ttf.
License: Montserrat-OFL.txt

Calibri Regular / Bold 6.23 — Microsoft Corporation. All rights reserved.
Font files obtained from https://github.com/wachin/Microsoft-Fonts/tree/main/microsoft-ttf
Family information: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/typography/font-list/calibri
Full font embedding is used for modified PDF text.

All dependencies are served locally with this page. No CDN or external API is used.
